lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-intensity circular blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits. The spots are arranged in a roughly rectangular grid, with the highest-intensity centroids located in the mid-lateral region between the primary horizontal ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots, forming distinct anchor nodes particularly visible in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running along the upper flank. They are characterized by a sharp luminance gradient, with the crest of each ridge reflecting light and casting a dark shadow immediately below it.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three thin, trailing white filaments are visible attached to the posterior edge of the pectoral fin, appearing as linear extrusions against the darker water background.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a unique high-density clustering of small, uniform spots that differs in scale and spatial distribution from the larger, more sparse blobs on the lateral flank.
